towns.name: Panama City
towns.watch: Hurricane exposure. Parts of town are still rebuilding from Michael in 2018
towns.blurb: A bayfront city on St. Andrews Bay with a reviving downtown and the Gulf beaches a bridge away.
towns.day: You grab coffee downtown, walk the marina in St. Andrews and drive 20 minutes to the beach when you feel like it.
todo: A waterfront district of seafood spots, a marina and a weekend market.
pros: More affordable than the beach side
A year round town, not just a resort
